cases.root_cause: The v1.4.8 deploy raised DB_POOL_SIZE to 100 per instance [F3, F4]; with 5 instances rolling out [F2], the fleet could demand up to 500 connections against a Postgres max_connections limit of ~100 [F5, F15], causing "too many connections" errors once enough new instances were live [F1, F10, F12].
cases.judge_reason: Both descriptions attribute the 'too many connections' error to increasing DB_POOL_SIZE from 20 to 100 per instance across five instances, resulting in potential demand for up to 500 connections while PostgreSQL allows only about 100.
